About

Projects

flowst8

September 2026

Contributor · Team of three · Hack The Hill III

A real-time productivity application designed to calculate dynamic focus scores, detect developer fatigue, and prompt timely breaks.

  • Built an end-to-end Python, FastAPI, and WebSocket pipeline to synchronize keystrokes per minute with live Apple Watch heart-rate telemetry.
  • Containerized microservices with Docker and used TimescaleDB for continuous time-series storage.
  • Integrated ElevenLabs audio alerts and connected the HTML/Next frontend with the Python/TypeScript backend.

Technologies Python · FastAPI · WebSockets · TypeScript · Next · Docker · TimescaleDB

Test-Shell

UNIX CLI shell simulator

A lightweight UNIX command-line interpreter in C, built to explore core operating-system interactions and essential shell functionality.

  • Used POSIX fork, execvp, and wait calls to create processes, execute child processes, and manage synchronization.
  • Implemented argument parsing and memory management to prevent leaks and mitigate zombie processes.

Technologies C · POSIX · UNIX · Process management

View Test-Shell source ↗

Poltergeist

Autonomous driving simulation & evaluation

A CARLA-based platform for creating hazardous driving scenarios, evaluating autonomous agents, and reviewing telemetry, sensor recordings, and failure evidence.

  • Built a React and TypeScript dashboard with a FastAPI backend to create, save, validate, and execute parameterized driving scenarios.
  • Implemented repeatable agent comparisons with matched seeds, failure search, reproduction, and scenario minimization.
  • Linked agent observations and proposed/applied controls to telemetry, synchronized RGB camera and LiDAR recordings, and behavior reports.
  • Integrated a Python agent SDK and pretrained PlanT 2.0 reference controller for local driving experiments.

Technologies Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · CARLA · SQLite · Pydantic
